contextKey.description: Compatibility shape only. Prefer `updates`/`replace`/`unset`. The context key to replace wholesale.

replace.description: Workflow-relative dot-paths whose values in `updates` are assigned wholesale. Allowed scope: any path under `context.<anything>` (page schemas like context.inputPages OR user-saved page values like context.outreachProfile) and `metadata`.

unset.description: Workflow-relative dot-paths to delete. Same allowed scope as replace[]. Each must currently exist on the workflow.

updates.description: Partial workflow patch keyed by `context` and/or `metadata`. Each is shallow-merged with the stored value; omitting siblings preserves them. Direct sub-objects (e.g. context.executionInputConfig) replace wholesale unless paired with replace[].

value.description: Compatibility shape only. New value for `contextKey`. Pass [] to clear a list.

name: update_workflow_context
